_timesSource:
Monday to Friday, 11:30am to 6pm. Source: Tajima marketing copy supplied by Steve on 2026-09-14.

HOW FAR THIS CAN BE TRUSTED, HONESTLY. This is client collateral, not a client answer. Two things limit it.

1. IT PREDATES A CLOSURE. The copy names North Park, which has been permanently closed since early 2026 and is not in locations.json. A document that still lists a closed room was written before that room closed, so the window in it describes a Tajima that no longer exists in at least one respect. It may describe the current one accurately too. Nobody has said so.

2. IT DOES NOT NAME THE ROOMS. The copy says 'select Tajima locations' and stops there. WE DO NOT GUESS WHICH. The window is applied only where this repo already establishes a bar or tap programme from CLIENT_FACTS.md: Mercury, College Heights, East Village, Convoy and Crown Point. Plaza Bonita is untouched, pours no alcohol, and its food-happy-hour question is still open (see _plazaReconciliation). If Amanda says the window runs at four rooms and not five, the ones to remove are here, not inferred.

ONLY THE TIMES WERE TAKEN. The surrounding copy is written in the retired 2025 voice and carries banned filler ('bold flavors', 'unbeatable deals', 'can't-miss prices', 'great vibes'). None of it is on the site and none of it goes on the site. See CLAUDE.md Forbidden Patterns.

WHAT THE PAGE SAYS ABOUT IT. /happy-hour/ prints the window and says plainly that it is not confirmed by the rooms, with the phone number beside it. That line is `timesNote` below. Do not delete it without a written confirmation from Amanda, because without one the page would be presenting sourced times as verified ones.

timesNote: These times come from Tajima's own marketing copy, not from the rooms. We are confirming them. Call ahead if you are making the trip for it.
_timesNote:
TWO STRINGS, ON PURPOSE. `timesNote` is the full sentence and runs once, under the section heading, where there is room to say where the times came from and what to do about it. `timesNoteShort` sits on every card that prints a window, directly under the time, so a reader who takes in one card and nothing else still sees that the number is not settled. Repeating the long sentence five times would be noise, and noise is how a caveat stops being read.

Both are data, not template copy. When Amanda confirms, soften or empty them here: the card and the section both render the note only if it is non-empty, so nothing in src/happy-hour.njk has to change.
_windowShape: The same shape as `hours` in locations.json: a days array and ISO 24-hour opens/closes. It is stored that way so the dayRange and clockTime filters format it, which is what makes a happy hour window and an operating hours row print identically on the same card. Do not store a pre-formatted string here: the last version of this file did, and the two kinds of time on the page would have been formatted by two different rules.
